newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan growth seen at 5.2 pct in '97 -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan growth seen at 5.2 pct in '97 -- paper.

text.p: The Venezuelan economy is seen growing 5.2 percent in 1997 after shrinking 1.6 percent last year, according to a Planning Ministry report leading daily El Nacional reported.
The report noted rising bank loans, increased private sector imports and car sales, and higher electricity consumption as signs of a growing recovery that began in the last quarter of 1996.

Earlier government economic growth estimates for this year have hovered around four percent, while state-owned oil company PdVSA has forecast 5.8 percent growth for 1997 rising to 7.8 percent in 1998.
